generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

As per karnataka state government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01-01-2007 and Govt letter No.PW/134/BMS /2007/dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details for reference
All the documents to be uploaded shall be neatly scanned and the documents scanned shall be in original
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditors reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarde
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.

All the Formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled in complete manner. ( section 3 & 4 of the bid document ) and shall be uploaded properly, signed by Tenderer . Necessary Certificates shall be uploaded along with the formats wherever required. General documents Section can be used for this purpose.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the financial bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.
Tenderers are requested to read the Bid Documents before submission of their bid.
Department will not supply any materials
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP Portal
The Employer reserves the rights reject one or all tender without assigning any reasons

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division Chikodi during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened next working day will holds good in lieu of the dates mentioned
The Tenderer are should be present during opening of the tender and also submit the uploaded documents duly attested by the Gazetted Officer not below the Rank of Executive Engineer
Contractors should Registered in KPWD and copy should be uploaded in KPPP Attested by the Gazzeted officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.(As per prevailing rates GST will be Paid Separately )
The Increase in G.S.T shall not be paid in the extended period of Contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
Difference amount should submit at the time of Agreement.
Financial turover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section
If no bid received auto extension will be done by KPPP Portal itself for 2 days
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) form practicing Chartered Account is preferred
As per Government Circular No. FD/263/EXP-12/2022,Dated 11/05/2022 L1 tenderer EMD amount is forfeited and tender will be rejected
This bid documents clause no 34.4 to be implemented as per deligation of power vide GO NO PWD 423 FC-1 2018 Banglore dated 24.09.2018
Any Deviation/error/Mistake found in units of items, they should be read as in the unified SR 2023-24 and rates shall be quoted accordingly
The Project Completion period is 3 months and the Tenderer should maintain work during the defect liability period, which is (1) One year after successful completion of the work.

The Tenderer shall achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover from financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26 of Rs. 39.86 Lakhs (not less than the estimated cost under this contract)

The Tenderer shall obtain similar the workdone certificate such as Providing Furniture work from financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26 (50% of the Amount Put to Tender i.e., Rs. 19.93 Lakhs) in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer(District Level Officer)and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid.
The EMD of Rs. 80,000/- shall be paid in full through e-payment in favour of Executive Engineer, PWD, Chikodi Dn, Chikodi

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing & Supplying Furnitures for New Bar Association building at Nippani Dist Belagavi

itemList.description:
Providing and laying  Vitrified tiles with thickness 9-10 mm in floor with different sizes with water absorption less than 0.08% and conforming to IS:15622, of approved brand & manufacturer, in all colours and shade, laid with cement based high polymer modified quick set tile adhesive (water based) conforming to IS : 15477, in average 6 mm thickness, including grouting of joints (Payment for grouting of joints to be made separately).
Size of Tile 600x600 mm

Providing  and  applying  white  cement  based  putty  of  average thickness 1  mm,  of   approved   brand   and   manufacturer,   over   the  plastered wall   surface   to prepare the surface even and smooth complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.

Wall  painting  with  plastic  emulsion  paint  of  approved  brand  and manufacture  to  give  an  even  shade:  One  coats  on  old  work  as  per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.

Applying  priming  coat:  With   ready   mixed   pink   or   Grey   primer   of approved  brand  and manufacture on wood work (hard and soft wood) including preparing the surface after thorougly cleaning oil, grease, dirt and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Painting wood work with Deluxe Multi Surface Paint of required shade. Two coat applied @ 0.90L/10 m² over an under coat of primer applied @0.75 L/10 m² of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade including preparing the surface after thorougly cleaning oil, grease, dirt and foreign matter, sand papering and knotting , cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Teak Wood Table : Of size 6'x3'. Leg size 2.5"x2.5". Table frame to be 4"x1.25" thick pattis. Foot rest to be provided with 2"x1.5"=2 Nos. Table top to be laminated with 1mm thick laminate with teak edge banding lower side middle H - Shape patti. Table shall be neatly finished and polished..

Conference Table :(Plywood with Laminated Top) Of size Height 2.5’ x Width 2’. Made out of18mm Plywood for Top and Front. With both side laminated and Front side closed. Inner side shall be provided suitable vertical support of 36mm Plywood. Table shall be provided with Footrest with suitable mm Plywood. Table Inner side shall be polish or paint. ( Rate per running
High Back Cushion Chair :- High back Chair with seat and back high quality feather touch Rexin. Arms with cushioning. Chair to have 5 caster wheel legs with Syncro Mechanisum.
Book Rack with glass : Of size 6'x3'x18". Made out of 18mm thick black board with 3 shelves laminated glass sheters, Inner side paint. Outer surface polish.

Teak Wood Chair (Heavy Model) : Seat with Teakwood Planks back with 6 or 8 patties. Made out of Teak wood Chair 3”x1.75 ” back legs 2 .25”X 2 .25” front Legs Chair side bars 3”x1 .25” back with 8 reapers. Chair size standard size. Chair shall be neatly finished and polished.

Wooden Partition: Frame made of 12 mm BWR Plywood of standared quality . The frame to be covered by 8mm BWR Ply on both sides. And finished with 1 mm Laminated on both sides. Total thickenss of the partition should be 3". All edges to be covered by 3" x 3/4" MDF/ Wooden molding. Rate per Sq Mtr

Notice Board : Of size 5'x3' using 18mm plywood for body, back 8mm plywood and 12mm soft board with cloth. And 5mm plain glass for door with lock, and alluminium chanal with teak wood beading. Outerside laminated sheet or veneer with polish, inner side paint or polish.

Teak Wood Horse Shoe Table : Of size overall Length 20'. L-16' x Width 2' or 2.5'x Height 2.5' =2 Nos. & 4' one "U" shape Table, such that when three table joined together and make one Horse shoe table. Leg size 2.5"x2.5" turning legs. Table upper portion patti of 4"x1.25" and bottom patti 2"x1.5". Top should be OST covered with Green cloth on top and front portion. Top should be provided with 8mm glass with Diamond polish. The Table shall be neatly finished and polished.

Providing and fixing Wooden Platform : Made out of teak wood of section 50x50mm of legs, 50x50mm for horizontals both at suitable intervals from the point of view of stability, the top of the platform covered with commercial block board of 25mm thick, all sides covered with 6mm thick one side teak plywood fixed firmly to the platform including joining the wooden sections properly using nails/ screws, fevicol including cost of wood, nails/screws, fevicol, cost of painting/polishing, labour, all lead and lift, cost of any incidental charges etc.(Rate Per Sq.Mtr)  ---- including cost of all materials, labor ,HOM,l & UL, curing with all leads and lifts etc. complete as per specifications & as directed by Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Wardrobe : Made out of 18mm OSR PLPB ( Actiontesa or Century brand) /Ply with lamination.(One side raw Prelaminated particle board) on three sides and back of 12mm PLPB. Inner design should have drawers in the center with lock. Top 3 ft should be open with 1 hanger rod . Bottomportion should have 1 shelf or innerside or 3 or 4 Selves. Exterior to be finished with laminate.
(Rate per Sqfeet)
